ROW.COLUMN: A sudden change in transaction activity may be suspicious and warrant additional investigation. This scenario monitors transaction activity and detects significant changes from the typical activity of an account which could be indicative of potential fraudulent behavior, such as payments fraud or account takeover.It identifies accounts that may be considered to be at risk by monitoring for changes in the types of products that are utilized by the account, (product utilization shift) among electronic funds transfers, check, monetary instrument, cash, and journal transactions.
